author: Bl broiler
title: Addicting - In a bad/expensive way
content:
I’ve been playing this game for close to 6 months, and I really enjoy it for the most part. However, my biggest complaint is that even when you get to level 150,200,300, or higher, I still find myself losing money (tickets) on each round. In a good day, 1 in about 15 rounds I’ll actually get my tickets back and profit a little bit, but typically I’ll get about 1/4 or less of what the rounds buy in is. (I.e. joining games that have a 6,000 ticket buy in, even with a couple double bingos and a jackpot bingo, I’ll only win maybe 4,000 tickets back. It’s so addicting though, that I’ve probably gave the game close to $400 at this point just so I can keep playing through various “sales” and micro transactions. Great game, but it is essentially gambling and is after your real money over everything else.

They also have been claiming to add features like interactions and mini games with friends for months now, and haven’t seen any news about them actually following through. I have my doubts.

TLDR; it’s a super fun and addictive bingo game, but very hard not to end up wasting a ton of real money buying the in-game “tickets” just so you can keep playing :(

Hopefully it gets better soon, but I’m not holding my breath. I’m sure they are making tons of money off us suckers and have no intention to change it…

author: JennBlue
title: Ruined a great game. The new "Blackout" mode is terrible.
content:
I used to play Bingo Voyage every single day, but I am officially uninstalling it. The developers completely changed the fundamental rules of the game, and it is no longer fun.
Instead of traditional bingo patterns, almost everything has been forced into a mandatory "Blackout" mode where you have to fill every single square on the card. It is statistically impossible to win without constantly burning through premium power-ups and boosts. This wasn't a change made to improve gameplay; it was a transparent cash grab designed to drain your tickets and force you to buy real-money upgrades like the temporary "Golden Ticket."
The ticket costs to enter a round are now ridiculously steep, and the gameplay has gone from a relaxing hobby to an aggressive, stressful resource sink. It’s a shame because this used to be a fantastic app. If you are looking for a fair, classic bingo game, look elsewhere. Vertex Games completely ruined this one by getting greedy. Daily player gone.

author: TheCrystalRose
title: Fun, but rewards are insulting
content:
So, this game is very addicting and I do love it. It’s entertaining, there are many events, and it’s not littered with ads. BUT, after playing this game for a while (at least a year or two), I have discovered a very glaring problem. 

Majority of the time, you will operate at a loss, or you will be lucky to break even without having to buy more tickets, and very rarely will you gain a profit, but most of the time the profit is small, and I mean insultingly small. (To be fair, on a very rare blue moon, you’ll get your double rewards which will award you a lot, but it’s few and far between)

It’s difficult to maintain enough tickets to play in the games; you do receive a daily allowance that you can collect about every 3 hours, which is nice, but once you reach far enough in the voyage, your allowance won’t cover the cost of a game at an entry level that is worth playing. 

Don’t get me wrong, the game is worth playing, and it is enjoyable despite this problem. But this is something I think the developers should consider addressing in the future.

author: 1jaxsgirl
title: Please read and take note
content:
This used to be my favorite game. The rotating bingo boards and frequent events kept things fresh, and winning Bingo felt fair. I also really enjoyed the alliance system, where players work together to earn rewards and help each other progress.

Unfortunately, that experience has completely changed. Getting Bingo has become nearly impossible I now win maybe 5-10% of the time. Considering how expensive it is just to play, constantly losing means you quickly run out of in game currency and can’t continue without paying. I used to enjoy the game enough to spend real money, but even that feels pointless now. To get any meaningful return, you’d need to spend an excessive amount (around 6000), and the smaller packages barely last through a single game especially when losses are so frequent.

The alliance system has also become a major issue. I’ve always been an active, supportive member. helping teammates, contributing rewards, and often being the top Bingo caller. Despite this, I’ve been kicked out of five different alliances simply for not logging in within 24 hours.

Here’s the reality: I have cancer. I started playing this game as a way to distract myself from pain and medical stress. I can’t control how sick I feel on any given day. Logging in after a rough day only to see I’ve been removed by people I supported feels like another blow when I’m already struggling.

This game used to bring me comfort and enjoyment. Now it feels unfair, expensive, and lacking basic compassion for its player base.

author: mdjehwgwvahidj
title: Followed your crash policy EXACTLY- still lost everything
content:
I’ve been playing this game for a little over a year, but over the past few months it has become nearly unplayable due to constant bugs. The game frequently glitches and freezes to the point where I can’t tap the screen, and when this happens I lose all the tickets, boosters, and coins I used.

I normally don’t mind when a game crashes—glitches happen, and I understand that. What’s frustrating is that this app never responds properly or provides fair compensation. Not only do they fail to return what’s lost, but they also don’t give enough tickets to even play another full game afterward. If this were a one-time issue and the app fairly compensated players so they could continue playing, I wouldn’t even consider writing this review.

Instead, this has happened repeatedly. From what I have documented, I’ve lost well over 7,800 tickets, 500+ coins, and 25+ boosters—and realistically, the total loss is probably closer to 14,000 tickets at this point. Beyond losing those resources, the crashes also cause me to miss out on side games and bonus rewards that are time-limited, meaning I lose entire opportunities to play and earn rewards—not just tickets.

I’ve read other reviews and seen the app’s responses stating that “compensation is usually sent automatically after a crash. If nothing appears, please reach out through the in-game help center so the team can look into your lost tickets and restore them.” I have done exactly that. I contact support immediately after each crash and provide proof every time. Despite following their instructions completely, I’ve received no compensation and no real response for months. When I do hear back, it’s never a message saying they’ve actually looked into the issue—it’s an automatic response sent immediately after I submit my complaint, asking me to rate their quality of service. I consistently rate it 1 star, because not a single ticket, booster, or coin has ever been returned, and I’ve never once received a response from an actual person.

Customer support’s actions do not match what they publicly claim will happen if users follow their process. Losing this many in-game resources—and opportunities to play—without accountability or resolution is unacceptable.

Very disappointing experience overall. Do not download if you don’t want to risk being scammed.
